title: NewTimesheet
role: Imaginatto — Software Development Intern, Full Stack
description: Timesheet management system built for Imaginatto in PHP with the CodeIgniter framework, replacing their legacy timesheet with a newly modelled database and business rules.
extendedDescription: This was my first ever real-life project, taken on as a software development intern. My job was renewing Imaginatto's timesheet system end to end: modelling the new database and coding the business rules in PHP with CodeIgniter, while primarily working under the supervision of the senior developers. I worked across the full stack — the back-end in PHP/CodeIgniter and the front-end built with Bootstrap. The system went on to be used company-wide for years after it was built.

title: Framework Alpha
description: PHP framework built for AM4 to standardise development across the company's web systems and webservices, packed with the shared code and functions used most often.
extendedDescription: Built together with another developer, this was a from-scratch PHP framework meant to speed up and standardise development across AM4 — reusable functions, patterns and boilerplate that the two of us, and later the rest of the team, relied on across a lot of projects afterwards. It was completely back-end, with no interface of its own, purely there to make everyday coding easier across the company's PHP projects.

title: ProgrammerTime
url: Estácio de Sá University — final year thesis (TCC)
role: Personal Project — Final Year Thesis (TCC), Full Stack
description: ProgrammerTime® is an internal management tool for software development companies to control projects, tasks, clients and employees in real time — built as my final year thesis at Estácio de Sá University.
extendedDescription: Built together with a course partner as our final thesis (TCC), scoring 10/10. ProgrammerTime® helps small, medium and large companies control their projects, tasks, clients and employees anywhere in real time, and was later adopted for real use by companies in Rio de Janeiro.
